resolution_notes: Ruled free_tier_limits and rate_limits from the official WeatherAPI.com pricing page. Free plan is 1,000,000 calls/month with published plan feature limits (forecast days, history, locations, commercial use). Rate limits are plan-dependent RPM shown on pricing (Free typically ~15/min; higher tiers scale). Both verifiers correctly flagged original “unknown”/“not published” as wrong; their corrections largely agree. Other entry fields left unchanged.
free_tier_limits: 1,000,000 calls/month; Free plan feature limits (e.g. forecast days, history window, locations, no commercial use) as published on pricing.aspx
rate_limits: Plan-dependent RPM on pricing page (Free ~15 calls/min; higher plans scale, e.g. Standard ~50/min)
